M EMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING 
 
 This Memorandum of Understanding (this “ Memorandum ”) is entered into at Lahore on this __________ 2023 (the “ Effective Date ”) by and between: 
 
 ZAMEEN MEDIA (PRIVATE) LIMITED , a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan, with its registered office at Pearl One, 94 B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, acting through its duly authorised representative [Mr. Adil Ahmad Kamal] (“ Zameen IT ” which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns). 
 
 AND 
 
 [ZAMEEN SALES XX ], a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan, with its registered office at Pearl One, 94 B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, acting through its duly authorised representative [●] (“ Zameen Sales ”, which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include successors-in-interest and permitted assigns). 
 
 AND 
 
 [ DEVELOPER XYZ ] , a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan, with its registered office at [●], Lahore, acting through its duly authorised representative [●] (“ Developer ” which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns). 
 
 (Zameen IT, Zameen Sales and the Developer shall also individually be referred to as “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”) 
 
 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is undertaking a real estate project, named and styled as ‘ [------] , comprising [●] (“ Unit(s) ”) , based on an area of [●] and located at [●] (“ Project ”); 
 
 Zameen IT is in the business of providing digital solutions and IT and IT-enabled services to real estate developers, including inter alia generation of leads to attract more audience towards the business of the Developer (“ IT Services ”) ; 
 
 Zameen Sales is in the business of providing sales services to real estate developers, including inter alia organising sales events, providing after-sales services , processing token refunds and collecting payments from buyers up to 30% of the sale proceeds from their real estate project (“ Sales Services ”) ; and 
 
 The Zameen IT and Zameen Sales are desirous providing the Developer with their respective IT Services and Sales Services , therefore the Parties are entering into this Memorandum for performance of the aforementioned services by Zameen IT and Zameen Sales with respect to the Project for the Developer . 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have signed th is Memorandum and are desirous of entering into this Memorandum for the purposes of recording their mutual understanding with respect to disbursal of p roceeds in relation to the Project . 
 
 SCOPE : Buyer shall deposit proceeds from Unit(s) sold in the Project into the Escrow Account , up to thirty percent (30%) of the down payment and the Escrow Agent shall be responsible for disbursement of payments to the Parties in accordance with this Memorandum for a period of [●] ( [●] ) years (“ Service Period ”). 
 
 SERVICE FEES 
 
 Zameen IT shall be entitled to a fee equal to PKR [●]/- ( Pakistani Rupees [●] only ) per lead generated for the Project during the Service Period (“ Service Fee - I ”). 
 
 Zameen Sales shall be entitled to a fee (“ Service Fee - II ”) , which shall be as follows: 
 
 fee equal to [●WORDS] percent ([●]%) of the Sale Price OR Quoted Price of all Units sold during the Service Period and / or for a period of ninety (90) days after expiry / termination hereof (“ Flat Fee ”); 
 
 In the event that p remium is earned on the sale of a Unit, the Developer shall pay fifty percent (50%) of the Premium (“ Zameen Sales ’ Share of Premium ”) to Zameen Sales ; 
 
 A marketing fee with respect to the product promotion activities conducted by Zameen Sales, which shall be equal to one percent (1%) of the Sale Price of all Units sold during the Service Period and / or for a period of ninety (90) days after expiry / termination hereof (“ Marketing Fee ”); and 
 
 I n the event that Developer charges the Buyer any cancellation fee, fifty percent (50%) of such fee shall be paid to Zameen Sales . (“ Cancelled Unit Fee ”). No fee shall be charged on cancellation of sale of any Unit for which less than ten percent (10%) of the Sale Price has been paid by the Buyer. 
 
 In case of cancellation of sale of any Unit, both Zameen Sales and the Developer shall return their respective share received against such cancelled Unit to the Buyer within fourteen (14) working days. 
 
 A Unit shall be deemed sold if a minimum of ten percent (10%) of the Sale Price of such Unit has been paid by the Buyer. 
 
 PAYMENT 
 
 Developer hereby undertakes to pay Zameen IT, the Service Fee – I , as consideration for the performance of IT Services, equal to PKR [●]/ (Pakistani Rupees [●] only) for every l ead generated by Zameen IT during the Service Period. 
 
 Developer hereby undertakes to pay Zameen Sales , the Service Fee – II in the following manner: 
 
 Developer shall pay [●] percent ( [●] %) of the Quoted Price to Zameen Sales on payment of [●] percent ( [●] %) of the Sale Price by the Buyer; 
 
 Developer shall pay a further [●] percent ( [●] %) of the Quoted Price to Zameen Sales on payment of further [●] percent ( [●] %) of the Sale Price by the Buyer, taking the aggregate down payment/instalment(s) to [●] percent ( [●] %) of the Sale Price; 
 
 Developer shall pay a further [●] percent ( [●] %) of the Quoted Price, along with Zameen Sales ’ Share of Premium (if any), to Zameen Sales on payment of further [●] percent ( [●] %) of the Sale Price by the Buyer, taking the aggregate down payment/instalment(s) to [●] percent ( [●] %) of the Sale Price. 
 
 In the event that more than ten percent (10%) of the Sale Price is paid by the Buyer as a single up front down payment, the proportionate Service Fee – II on pro-rata basis shall be paid to Zameen Sales . 
 
 Zameen IT shall issue invoices to the Developer periodically for payment of the Service Fee – I with respect to IT Services rendered during the invoice period. 
 
 Zameen Sales shall invoice the Developer within three (3) days after every sale of a Unit(s), payment of every down payment/, cancellation of sale by the Buyer or for any other fee/payment due to Zameen Sales . 
 
 Developer understands and acknowledges that any dispute or objection in respect of any invoice of Zameen IT and Zameen Sales shall be intimated in writing within three (3) days from the date of invoice. If Zameen IT and Zameen Sales do not receive an objection within three (3) days from the date of invoice, then it shall be deemed that the Developer accepts the invoice. Moreover, the Developer shall have no right to raise any objection after the lapse of three (3) days from the date of invoice. 
 
 All applicable taxes shall be borne by either P arty as per local law(s). All invoices shall be subject to applicable withholding tax and sales tax. 
 
 ESCROW ACCOUNT 
 
 In order to ensure security of payments under this Memorandum , the Parties agree and undertake to open an escrow account for collection and disbursal of proceeds ( “Escrow Account” ), wherein the Developer shall collect all deposits against Inventory sold by the Developer up to a maximum of thirty percent (30%) of the [minimum price / sale price / quoted price] of a Unit. The funds deposited in the Escrow Account shall ultimately be disbursed in the manner set-out hereunder, which shall be subject to collection of a minimum balance equal to ten percent (10%) of the [minimum price / sale price / quoted price] of a Unit. 
 
 The Developer hereby grants an exclusive right and authorizes Escrow Agent to collect, for and on behalf of the Developer , down payments (in lump sum or in partial down payment(s)) up to thirty percent (30%) of the Sale Price from the Buyer of any Unit included in Project’s inventory and sold or booked during the Service Period or such other time period as may be mutually agreed with respect to the Units’ pending approvals and transfer/deposit such amount in the Escrow Account. Each such deposit shall be made within one (1) business day of receipt of proceeds from the Project or any part thereof. 
 
 The Escrow Account shall be opened with a scheduled bank of Pakistan mutually agreed between the Parties (“ Escrow Agent ”), in the denomination of the Pakistan Rupee and registered at a branch of bank in [ ]. 
 
 The Escrow Account shall be opened and remain operational during the Service Period or such other time period as may be mutually agreed between the Parties. All the expenses, fees, cost and taxes associated with the opening and operations of the Escrow Account, shall be borne by the Developer. 
 
 The Parties shall do and cause to be done all such acts, deeds and things as lawfully required for the purpose of opening and operating the Escrow Account, including but not limited to entering into an escrow agreement with the Escrow Agent, providing corporate and constitutive documents, and completing signature cards, as well as for closure of the Escrow Account. 
 
 Funds from the Escrow Account shall be disbursed in light of approved invoices and on the basis a letter of instruction issued by the Parties to the Escrow Agent. The Escrow Agent shall only disburse funds from the Escrow Account strictly in accordance with the letter of instruction duly signed by the authorised representative / signatory of each Party. 
 
 Within three (3) days of acceptance of the invoice or resolution of any objection, the Parties shall issue a letter of instruction to the Escrow Agent, with signatures of the authorized representatives of Zameen IT / Zameen Sales (as appropriate) and the Developer , for disbursal of the funds in the following manner: 
 
 The Escrow Agent shall deduct Service Fee – I and / or Service Fee – II as appropriate, and/or any other charges, payments or fees payable to Zameen IT / Zameen Sales as per the invoice and disburse the same amount in the bank account provided in Annexure [●]. For the avoidance of doubt, adjustment of Service Fee – I and Service Fee – II under this clause shall be deemed as full and final settlement of the applicable service fee (s) that the Developer is liable to pay to Zameen IT and Zameen Sales , respectively ; and 
 
 After the deduction of payments, the remaining amount shall be disbursed in the bank account of the Developer . 
 
 Immediately upon receipt of letter of instructions from the Parties, the Escrow Agent shall disburse the funds as standing to the credit of the Escrow Account and any delay by the Escrow Agent in the disbursal of payment(s) shall result in an automatic proportionate extension of the Service Period. In the event that any funds remain in the Escrow Account after disbursement , the Parties shall issue further written instructions to the Escrow Agent for disbursal of such remaining funds to the Parties. If any funds remain in the Escrow Account after expiry of the Service Period , the Parties shall issue final written instructions to the Escrow Agent for disbursal of such remaining funds before closing the Escrow Account. 
 
 DEVELOPER RESPONSIBILITIES 
 
 Developer hereby represents that it is the absolute owner of the Project and its land area or holds a valid attorney from the land owner to develop and sell the Project, which is free from any lien, charge, encumbrance and shall remain unencumbered throughout the Service Period. The Developer shall further obtain all necessary permissions, approvals and NOCs for the Project from all competent authorities: land, revenue and/or any other department; federal, provincial and/or local governments, or any other department(s) or authority( ies ) concerned, as and when required. 
 
 Developer shall strictly adhere to the construction schedule (“ Schedule of Work ”) in respect of the Project. In the event that Developer fails to adhere to the Schedule of Work and work on the site has been halted for a period exceeding thirty (30) days, all s ervices (after consultation) in respect of the Project, maybe suspended, after informing the Developer in writing. 
 
 Parties shall share on a monthly basis, an up-to-date monthly report(s), statement(s) of account(s) and/or any document(s) relating to the booking/sale of any Unit(s) in the Project’s inventory sold during the Service Period. 
 
 Developer confirms that Zameen IT and Zameen Sales shall not be liable in any manner for any delay or failure on the part of the Buyer to make any payment/instalment up to thirty percent (30%) of the Sale Price. 
 
 CONFIDENTIALITY : All Parties shall not disclose, without prior written approval from the other Party, any information regarding this Memorandum. Furthermore, the Developer under stands and agrees that the Developer shall not disclose any trade secrets and strategies as are employed by Zameen IT and Zameen Sales. 
 
 TERMINATION : Upon termination, the Parties agree that Zameen Sales shall provide to the Developer , within thirty (30) days from the date of termination notice, a list of Units that are in pipeline for sale for which valid tokens are available with collection agent. Zameen Sales shall collect the down-payment from Buyers, within thirty (30) days from the date of booking and sale of such Units. For the avoidance of doubt, the Developer shall be liable to p ay Zame e n Sales the Service Fee with respect to the Units. 
 
 NOTICES : Any notice to be given under this Memorandum shall be deemed delivered after twenty-four (24) hours of being sent. Written letters shall be deemed to have been delivered after three (3) working days of being posted, provided such letters were sent via a reputable courier company. 
 
 RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN PARTIES : Nothing contained in this Memorandum shall be construed or deemed to create any association, partnership or joint venture, agency, or employer-employee relationship in any manner whatsoever between the Parties. 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF , the Parties have signed the Memorandum , having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will .
